title: The ALPINE-ALMA [CII] survey: Data processing, catalogs, and statistical source properties
question: Process the ALPINE ALMA band-7 data into continuum and [CII] catalogs and derive basic dust and [CII] properties, number counts and redshift distribution of serendipitous continuum sources

data.sensitivity: continuum ~30 uJy RMS; [CII] 0.14 Jy km/s in 235 km/s

what.value: Ancillary properties (SFR, stellar mass, UV luminosity) of ALPINE targets

evidence.quote: The far-UV luminosity, L$_{FUV}$, is provided by the ancillary ALPINE catalog presented in (cite: Faisst2020).

what.value: SED templates (Bethermin2017 adopted; Schreiber2018, Alvarez-Marquez2016 compared)

evidence.quote: Since the $\chi^2$ of (cite: Bethermin2017) is marginally better, we decided to use this template.

what.value: Absolute CIB level used as reference

evidence.quote: Their values are used as the reference CIB level in this paper.

recipe.method: Observatory pipeline re-run with fracspw=0.03125 and extra antenna flagging

recipe.goal: Image cubes, continuum and moment-0 maps
recipe.method: tclean natural weighting, MFS continuum, uvcontsub, tapered maps

recipe.goal: Extract continuum sources and set purity threshold
recipe.method: Local maxima in S/N maps; purity from negative maps; 5 sigma in field, 3.5 sigma within 1 arcsec of targets
Peak, 2D Gaussian fit, 3 arcsec aperture, 2-sigma clipped; 2D-fit adopted

recipe.goal: Completeness, flux boosting, effective area, number counts and CIB
recipe.method: Inject Gaussian sources of 4 sizes and 18 fluxes (10 per pointing, 10 repeats); derive completeness, deboosting, effective area; counts as sum of 1/Omega_eff
assumptions: Fluxes converted to 850 um using z=2.5 main-sequence Bethermin2017 SED template

recipe.goal: Derive 158 um continuum to L_IR conversion via Herschel stacking
recipe.method: Mean stacking of SFR>10 Msun/yr COSMOS sources at 4<z<5 and 5<z<6; fit templates with free normalization
assumptions: Bethermin2017 template with no evolution above z~4 (<U>=50)

recipe.method: Running-average moment-0 cubes (2-40 channels) in 1" cylinder, S/N>3 peaks, Gaussian fit, iterate 2-sigma region spectra; 95% purity at S/N>3.56

recipe.goal: Stack continuum by [CII] luminosity to get SFR-L[CII]
recipe.method: Image-plane stacking in four L[CII] bins and z<5 / z>5, aperture photometry, SFR_tot=SFR_IR+SFR_UV

evidence.quote: We detected 23 of our 118 targets in continuum above 3.5 $\sigma$ threshold corresponding to a 95 % purity.
We obtained 75 \[CII\] detections out of our 118 targets.
The mean redshift of our sample is z=2.5$\pm$0.2 (median = 2.3$\pm$0.3)
We found a median luminosity of $(4.8 \pm 0.4) \times 10^{8}$ L$_\odot$

answer_key.quantity: CIB contribution of >0.35 mJy sources (full sample)

evidence.quote: 0.093$\pm$0.013 MJy/sr for the full sample and 0.054$\pm$0.009 MJy/sr for the secure sample
the effective surface area is the total area of all our pointings[^5] (24.92 arcmin$^{2}$)

not_stated_but_needed: Exact CASA version used for pipeline and tclean
Number of clean iterations/mask specifics, spectral cube channelization for final cubes
Exact bootstrap settings for stacking and error bars
Line-free channel ranges per source (only rule given)
Exact catalog of manual spw fixes
Details of uv-fit and stacking in unpublished companion papers
score_reason: Public data and a detailed recipe, but the ancillary catalogs, CASA version and several steps deferred to companion papers or unpublished work.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is largely specified, and the results are numeric (detection counts, medians, conversion factors).
